description: Designed by scripts/director.py design (seed 73): the roles, ages, styles and colours were dealt by code, the rooms written from the picture of the wallpaper by a model; each slot carries its own kit. Re-shoot under a NEW set name.

kit.name: Birch flower table and bouclé poufs
kit.subject: a calm biophilic bedroom for a child aged 2 to 5, with a flower-shaped birch craft table and a stack of bouclé poufs
kit.room: A bright airy room with a wide-plank walnut floor.
kit.floor: On an oval oat bouclé rug lie wax crayons in a wooden cup and an open drawing book, beside a small wooden watering can.
kit.side_wall: a low flower-shaped pale lacquered birch craft table 45 cm high with a stack of round bouclé poufs in ochre and barberry red, a round birch shelf with two sage ceramic pots of small ferns, and a framed leaf print above
kit.light: Warm golden hour sunlight from a window on the {side} lies in long soft patches on the floor.
kit.palette: muted sage, pale birch, oat, ochre, barberry red and warm white
kit.items: flower-shaped craft table, bouclé poufs, oval rug, wax crayons, drawing book, round shelf, picture frame and architecture
kit.life_pose: {person} stands on the rug with {her} back to the camera, {her} face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible.
kit.toy: wax crayons in a wooden cup with an open drawing book on the rug

kit.name: Oak storage bed, retro butter yellow
kit.subject: a sunny retro room for a schoolchild aged 6 to 10, with a low solid oak single bed with storage drawers and a low book shelf
kit.room: A bright room with a cream and caramel checked linoleum floor.
kit.floor: A rectangular crocheted play mat in mustard, cream and brown stripes lies by the bed with a wooden spinning top, a vintage tin car and a stack of board games.
kit.side_wall: a low solid oak single bed 90 by 200 cm with under-bed drawers and butter yellow linen, beside it a 70 cm oak shelf with a few chapter books and a wooden pencil cup, and a small framed vintage map above
kit.light: Crisp morning daylight from a window on the {side} falls in clear bands across the floor.
kit.palette: butter yellow, honey oak, caramel, cream, mustard, sage and white
kit.items: oak bed, storage drawers, low shelf, chapter books, pencil cup, crocheted mat, wooden toys, picture frame and architecture
kit.life_pose: {person} stands on the rug with {her} back to the camera, {her} face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible.
kit.toy: a few chapter books and a wooden pencil cup standing on a low shelf beside the bed

kit.name: Birch floor bed, circus stripes
kit.subject: a playful fun-haus bedroom for a child aged 2 to 5, with a low birch Montessori floor bed and an arched cream cabinet
kit.room: A light room with a pale ash herringbone floor.
kit.floor: On a pill-shaped cream rug with wavy edges lie wax crayons in a wooden cup and an open drawing book.
kit.side_wall: a low solid birch Montessori floor bed with caramel-and-cream striped bedding and one blue cushion, an arch-fronted cream cabinet 55 cm high beside it, and a small framed vintage circus print
kit.light: Warm golden hour sunlight from a window on the {side} lies in soft patches on the floor.
kit.palette: cocoa brown, caramel, cream, brick, saturated blue and pale ash
kit.items: birch floor bed, striped bedding, arched cabinet, pill-shaped rug, wax crayons, drawing book, picture frame and architecture
kit.life_pose: {person} stands on the rug with {her} back to the camera, {her} face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible.
kit.toy: wax crayons in a wooden cup with an open drawing book on the rug
